methodology: Interleaved before/after runs with reversed order on alternate trials; fresh browser contexts, 1600x1000 viewport, external Google font CSS blocked equally. Startup ends at sb-ready plus two animation frames. Large cases include 20 scattered navigation calls, a real title edit followed by first and nine warm JSON state collections, and five independent filmstrip scrolls. Timings exclude server startup. Durations are milliseconds; medians are across trials; no CPU profiler runs during timing.
